name: Target repo writes require explicit authority and rollback
decision: KRN target-repo work must declare mode, dirty state, write authority, allowed files, forbidden writes, rollback, verification, and proof/non-proof before changing a target repository.
falsifier: A future target-repo task writes to a living or fixture target without explicit mode, dirty-state handling, allowed/forbidden writes, rollback, and verification while tests still pass.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove target writes are safe by default, external target readiness, second-operator proof, or product readiness.
